title: Integrate runtime consumers for staged bounded-procedure request kinds (hazard-save, weapon-damage, feature-option)
description: executeBoundedProcedure (packages/core/src/rules/boundedProcedures.ts) executes six request kinds; only create-spell-slot and convert-spell-slot have a production consumer (state/flexibleCasting.ts). hazard-save, weapon-damage, select-feature-option and feature-option-applicability have none, so the capability inventory (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.4) records the executor as retained-staged. This bead owns deciding and wiring (or demoting) their consumers. Found while tabulating the inventory.
